the WSL2 leg runs a prebuilt nextest archive (plan 2.2): the guest has no cargo or rustc, so it cannot build the biscuit-harness-broker binary the L2 tier needs, and no terminal server runs there. Installing tmux in the guest would satisfy which("tmux") while executing zero L2 tests — the non-evidence plan 1.1 rejects. Closes when the broker ships inside the archive and the guest starts a tmux server; tractable without solving the Windows backend problem, hence the earlier expiry.
